ResourceHeader.ResourceName: ICON Extreme Ultraviolet Night Time Oplus Images
ResourceHeader.Description:
ICON Night time Oplus climatology. The L3 FUV Night Limb files are produced from the L2.5 ICON FUV Night files.
     All variables within the file are described in their Var_notes attribute. The data are identified in one of 2 var_types: data – which
     contains the primary data product and support data – which contains parameters used in the retrieval such as geometry etc. that may also
     be useful in any analysis of this data.  This single file spans the whole mission

Parameter.Name: Epoch Time
Parameter.Description: Time corresponding to the middle of each 48 day average, in milliseconds since Jan 1 1970.

Parameter.Name: 48 day bins
Parameter.Description: Dates used in each 48 day bin, in string format, in the format: 2017-05-27.

Parameter.Name: Binned O+ Density
Parameter.Description: Mean value of FUV nighttime O+ Density, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of altitude,longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ICON_L24_Disk_ON2.

Parameter.Name: Binned HMF2
Parameter.Description: Binned HMF2. Mean value of HMF2, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ICON_L25_HMF2..

Parameter.Name: Binned NMF2
Parameter.Description: Electron density at the peak of the F2 layer from retrieval. Mean value of NMF2, taken over all good quality L2 datapoints in a 48-day time-span, as a function of longitude, latitude, time. Derived from ICON_L25_NMF2.

Parameter.Name: Number of data points
Parameter.Description: Number of data points in each 48 day average, as a function of altitude, longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma O+ Density
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good O+ values used to compute the mean, as a function of altitude, longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma HMF2
Parameter.Description: 1 standard deviation of the good column HMF2 values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Sigma HMF2
Parameter.Description: Electron density at the peak of the F2 layer from retrieval. 1 standard deviation of the good column NMF2 values used to compute the mean, as a function of longitude, latitude, time.

Parameter.Name: Binned Altitude Grid
Parameter.Description: Altitude of the O+ data, binned in 4 km intervals, altitude +/- 2.0 km. Derived from ICON_L25_O+_Profile_Altitude.

Parameter.Name: Local Time Bin
Parameter.Description: Local time binned in 0.5 hour intervals, local time +/- 0.25 hours.

Parameter.Name: Latitude Bin
Parameter.Description: Latitude of the O+ data, binned in 5 degree intervals, latitude +/- 2.5 degrees. Derived from ICON_L25_O+_Profile_Latitude.

Parameter.Name: Longitude Bin
Parameter.Description: Longitude of the O+ data, binned in 15 degree intervals, longitude +/- 7.5 degrees. Derived from ICON_L25_O+_Profile_Longitude.
